title: Coastal Canopy | KEY.co
description_expanded: Just steps from the sugar-white sands of 30A, this five-bedroom, four-bathroom haven in Twin Palms invites guests into a world of coastal elegance and effortless comfort. Designed with refined relaxation in mind, every corner of this newly built retreat—affectionately known as “Coastal Canopy”—blends style with serenity. The open-concept living area features plush, contemporary furnishings, while the gourmet kitchen and thoughtfully designed bedrooms provide the perfect backdrop for unwinding after a sun-soaked day. The crown jewel of the home is its private rooftop terrace, where panoramic views of the Gulf set the stage for unforgettable moments. Whether it's grilling under the stars, sipping coffee at sunrise, or catching golden-hour glows over the water, the rooftop experience is simply unmatched. With its unbeatable location just minutes from 30A Avenue’s upscale shops and restaurants, Coastal Canopy offers a seamless blend of indulgence, convenience, and barefoot luxury.
